placements.title: Release Integrity Through Signing Gates
placements.theme: Deployment authority flows through signed release manifests that gate every environment.
placements.why: The document establishes an organizational category — release management through deployment gating via signed manifests — that no existing strata covers. The core gate declarations (src-1, src-3) define this category's scope.

placements.title: Signed Manifests Gate Meridian Deploys
placements.theme: Meridian deployments require a signed release manifest before reaching staging or production, owned by the CTO.
placements.why: All five segments support the thematic subject of the Meridian deployment gate: the requirement (src-1, src-3), the triggering incident of unsigned artifacts reaching staging (src-2), the scope covering staging and production (src-4), and CTO ownership (src-5). The incident and ownership are facts that evidence the gate's necessity and authority, not standalone themes.
